description: Source file for dialog-related functionalities in the Battle for Wesnoth game, including unit advancement, save/load dialogs, and UI panes.

classes.name: delete_save
classes.description: Handles deletion of saved game files with user confirmation.

classes.name: save_preview_pane
classes.description: Displays a preview of saved game data including map and metadata.

classes.name: unit_preview_pane
classes.description: Displays a preview of a unit, including image, description, and stats.

classes.name: campaign_preview_pane
classes.description: Displays a preview of campaign scenario descriptions and images.

methods.name: advance_unit
methods.description: Advances a unit to a new type or level, with dialog options.

methods.name: animate_unit_advancement
methods.description: Animates the process of a unit advancing to a new type.

methods.name: show_objectives
methods.description: Displays the objectives of a level in a dialog.

methods.name: get_save_name
methods.description: Prompts user for a save game filename, with overwrite confirmation.

methods.name: load_game_dialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to load saved games, with summaries and previews.

methods.name: unit_speak
methods.description: Displays dialog messages from units matching filter criteria.

methods.name: show_unit_description
methods.description: Shows help dialog for a specific unit.
